sn51.11:2.2: My energy won’t be too lax or too tense. And it’ll be neither constricted internally nor scattered externally.
sn51.11:2.4: as before, so behind; as behind, so before;
sn51.11:2.5: as below, so above; as above, so below;
sn51.11:2.6: as by day, so by night; as by night, so by day.
sn51.11:2.7: And so, with an open and unenveloped heart, they develop a mind that’s full of radiance.
